canonical_project: AWS Lisbon Local Zone (AWS European Sovereign Cloud)
notes: AWS announced Lisbon, Portugal Local Zone (eusc-de-east-1-lis-1a) under the AWS European Sovereign Cloud Germany parent region; presented in Lisbon 20 April 2026 with the Portuguese government; estimated ~EUR 3bn GDP impact and 17,000+ jobs. Cloud edge/connectivity signal - not a full AWS Region; official region lists show no standard AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI Portugal public region.
